name: japanese-reading-helper
description: Chrome extension: Japanese phrase breaks, particle colors, hover furigana and jisho meanings.

scripts.vendor: mkdir -p lib dict && cp node_modules/kuromoji/dict/*.gz dict/ && sed -E 's/path\.join\(dic_path, ([^)]*)\)/dic_path + \1/g' node_modules/kuromoji/build/kuromoji.js > lib/kuromoji.js
scripts.pack: rm -f japanese-reading-helper.zip && zip -qr japanese-reading-helper.zip manifest.json background.js content.js content.css popup.html popup.js icons lib dict README.md
